readingUncertainties: Flight number CR893 is used twice (23/09 MAD-DUB and 24/09 MAD-LIS). That is what is printed; I did not correct it.
OFF rows carry no station, so the location shown for each day off is inferred from where the previous duty ended.

derivations.method: STA 20:30 is ORD local on 01/09 as printed; converted it lands 02/09 01:30Z. Block 9h00 confirms the reading.
STA 13:50 is earlier than STD 21:50, so the arrival is the next MAD local day (04/09). Block 9h00 confirms: 04/09 02:50Z + 9h00 = 04/09 11:50Z.
STD 23:10 JFK on 07/09, STA 13:10 MAD taken as 08/09 local; block 8h00 confirms 08/09 03:10Z + 8h00 = 08/09 11:10Z.
MAD-FCO departs 23:55 on 11/09 so its STA 02:20 and the following FCO-MAD 03:23/05:48 are 12/09 local. Duty length 14h53 from report 15:25 (11/09) to off duty 06:18 (12/09) confirms the roll-over.
Off Duty 00:14 is after the 23:44 arrival, so it is 25/09 MAD local = 24/09 22:14Z. Duty 11h54 from report 10:20Z confirms.
STA 08:10 and Off Duty 08:40 are SIN local on 27/09 (STA earlier than STD 12:40); block 13h30 confirms 26/09 10:40Z + 13h30 = 27/09 00:10Z.
